name: web-to-skill-pipeline
title: 网页取证 → 方法提炼 → Skill 落盘 工作流
description: Turns user-supplied URLs, paper lists, scholar pages, or documentation sites into a reusable methodology skill. Covers evidence-chain building with fallback paths when sources are blocked, source reliability tiering, method extraction from a body of works, portability testing that separates method from the subject's resource conditions, local skill-directory convention discovery and de-duplication, and synthetic-data self-checks for executable artifacts.
